messages.subject: Using Twitter feeds in IO - cashe OAuth
parts:
I am working on a project for Coursera and I am using Twitter feeds.  I am near ready to upload, but I am unsure of how it will behave on initial start up.  At my local consul, I need to make a choice in R studio from the menu below before the code will fully execute in the browser.





I normally select 2 at my keyboard - then everything runs fine - while I maintain the cache.  How will this work on Shiny IO?  I have not tried to upload it yet, hoping that others may have solved this already.

Robert

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Using Twitter feeds in IO - cashe OAuth
parts:
You would need to select 1, and unfortunately due to a bug in the IDE, you will need to deploy your application up to shinyapps.io with the rsconnect::deployApp() call so that the .httr-oauth file gets uploaded (it is a bug that I am hoping gets fixed with the next IDE release).

Hope this helps.
